name: personal-memory
description: Memco Personal Memory gives your agents a private, portable memory of your preferences. Load them at the start of every session; save what you learn.

interface.shortDescription: Private, portable memory for your preferences
interface.longDescription: Memco Personal Memory gives your agents a private, portable memory of your preferences. Agents load your identity and preferences at the start of every session and save durable ones as they learn them — so how you like to work travels with you across tools and machines.
